title: chat-server: addRoles requires client-supplied id
description: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs:143 parses each Space/set addRoles entry with parse_entry::<SpaceRole>, which requires `id`. Draft 1e33ec7 §Space/set addRoles: "Each entry: name (String), permissions (String[]), position (UnsignedInt), and optionally color ... Server assigns ULIDs." jmap-chat-client SpaceAddRoleInput (correctly) sends no id, so every client addRoles fails with invalidProperties "addRoles[0]: failed to parse entry: missing field `id`". Found while writing a chat_client_wire.rs round-trip test for JMAP-yt1w.2 role colors; once fixed, add that wire test (addRoles with hex/Design Tokens/CAM16 colors, then Space/get returns each color verbatim).
notes: Done in c9cb992: tests add_roles_without_id_get_distinct_server_assigned_ids, add_roles_after_remove_does_not_reuse_freed_id, space_add_roles_round_trips_each_color_representation; changed existing tests: none
